text: {"name":"bt_send_connection_complete_event","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Builds and submits an eight-byte connection event using status and parameters from the indexed connection record.","subsystem":"bt","var_renames":{"a2":"connection_index","v4":"event_packet","v5":"connection","v6":"connection_state"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":12,"meaning":"16-bit connection parameter copied to event bytes 6–7."},{"offset":17,"meaning":"Connection state; value 1 maps to a success status."},{"offset":20,"meaning":"16-bit connection value copied to event bytes 4–5, likely the connection handle."},{"offset":22,"meaning":"Byte copied to event byte 2."}]}
